title: FishingTracker
description: A Fabric client-side mod that tracks your fishing session in real time. Monitor XP, job points, party fishing stats, and boju effects via HUD, with automatic session summary on timer end.
body:
# 🎣 FishingTracker

A Fabric client-side mod that tracks your fishing session data in real time through an in-game HUD.

> ⚠️ **Notice**: This mod was built for a specific private server.
> It may not function correctly on other servers.

## ✅ Features

- Real-time tracking of Job XP, Skill XP, Job Points, and Bonus Blessings
- Party fishing entropy & adaptability tracking
- Hotspot / Storm's Call boju effect counter
- Skill & Job booster remaining time display (warning at 5 min or less)
- Automatic session summary in chat when timer ends
- Elapsed timer auto-pauses after 10 seconds without a catch
- Drag HUD to any position by holding F8

## ⌨️ Keybinds

| Key | Function |
|---|---|
| F6 | Reset all session data |
| F7 | Toggle HUD visibility |
| F8 | Hold to enter HUD drag mode |

## 💬 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/낚시 타이머 <min>` | Set a countdown timer |
| `/낚시 타이머 중지` | Stop the timer |
| `/낚시 위치 <x> <y>` | Set HUD position manually |
| `/낚시 위치 초기화` | Reset HUD to top-right corner |
| `/낚시 크기 <50~200>` | Adjust HUD scale (default: 100) |

## ⏱️ Timer Feature

Use `/낚시 타이머 30` to set a 30-minute session goal.
A countdown will appear on the HUD, and when time is up,
a full session report is automatically printed in chat, including:

XP · Skill XP · Fish count · Party fishing stats
Boju effects · Job points · Bonus blessings · Total points
Special drops · Total active fishing time

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
